notes.title: Upcoming Balancing Changes – Based on Your Feedback 💚
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone💚,[/p][p]As many of you in the community already know, [b]player feedback is extremely important to me[/b]—and I take it very seriously. Since the very first [b]0.6 version[/b], countless features and improvements have been shaped directly by your ideas and suggestions. This collaboration with all of you is what helps make the game better with every update.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the next few updates, I’ll be sharing a series of changes and improvements you can expect in the upcoming [b]1.0 release[/b]. While I know this doesn’t directly affect the current [b]0.9 version[/b], I hope it’s reassuring to see how things are improving and evolving based on your input.
[/p][p]To kick things off, let’s take a look at the first big set of adjustments:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Upcoming Energy System Improvements[/b][/h3][p]Many of you shared that energy management felt a bit too challenging at the start of the game. After listening to your feedback, I’ve made some adjustments for the upcoming version 1.0 💚
[/p][p]That said, I still want to keep the core design choice:[/p][p]In the beginning, the game is meant to feel a little tough, so that upgrades, new blobs, blueprints, and buildings feel rewarding as you progress.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s changing with the energy system in 1.0:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Increased starting energy:[/b] from 175 → 250[/p][p]→ This gives you more breathing room before you need to eat or heal.[/p][p][i](Based on feedback that energy drained too quickly.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tournament rewards improved:[/b] Winning a tournament now raises your max energy by 25, up to 425 total.[/p][p]→ This makes tournaments feel more impactful for progression.[/p][p][i](Based on requests to expand maximum energy.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tool energy costs rebalanced:[/b][/p][p]Fishing rod: 10 → 4[/p][p]Bug net: 5 → 4[/p][p]All tools/actions now cost 4 energy, and with skills unlocked, some can go as low as 3.[/p][p][i](Especially fishing had lots of feedback that 10 was way too high.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]New beginner recipe:[/b] Smoothie[/p][p]Ingredients (very easily found in the first starting season): 1 wild raspberry + 2 apples[/p][p]Restores 70 energy[/p][p][i](Based on feedback that early-game lacked simple recipes.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Early Access games will always have their rough edges, and I’m truly [b]grateful for all the feedback you’ve shared about the energy system so far[/b]. Your input helps me shape the game into something better with every update.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have more thoughts or ideas, please don’t hesitate to share them—either by joining the [url="https://discord.gg/2Ew83HTX"]Discord [/url]community or posting here in the [b]Steam forum[/b]. Every bit of feedback counts! 💚

Thank you for reading!
~Claudia[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/55d787005344b94d43c430b2acf087111c271160.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: NEW MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE✨
notes.notes:
[i]Note: Make sure to update to the [b]0.905 version[/b]. If Steam doesn't update automatic, restart Steam. On Steam Deck games sometimes do not launch after updates, in this case restart your Steam Deck.[/i]

This update features new content and also lots of improvements based on your feedback.
The team uses this occasion to thank all players who left us kind words, suggestions and ideas 🙏. Your support during Early Access helps a lot!

We are looking forward to the full release and improving the game further during the remaining Early Access period. If you have more feedback and ideas do not hesitate to reach out via the Steam Forum or our [url=https://discord.gg/DcWXRqKAZQ]Discord[/url].

Please also leave a Steam review if you enjoy playing Ova Magica - it helps a lot to get some visibility💚 !

Below are SPOILERS, so stop reading here if you prefer to play the new content blind and figure out how to unlock the new features for yourself.


[h1]ROADMAP CONTENT[/h1]

[h3][b]NEW BLOB WORLD: PREHISTORIC BADLANDS[/b][/h3]
Venture with Lapis into the blob world and discover the secret of the legendary blob fossil egg! The blob world comes as always with new blobs to collect.

[previewyoutube=z5-027Gbqxs;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]How to unlock:
Fill the level 4 heart fully for Lapis and Lazuli to unlock their new friendship event. The event is a special “duo event”. Follow the quests of the event to gain access to the Prehistoric Badlands.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/a005c59c883a560ac931e1c4da6624c967310acd.png[/img]

[h3][b]DREAM AREA - SKIP SEASONS FEATURE[/b][/h3]
If you are still missing some seasonal or festival items you can now skip quickly to the required season:
Re-visit the Keeper of Time. The blob gifts you a legendary egg and offers you to progress time to the next season.

[i]How to unlock: Available the day after completing Jade's level 4 heart event (in which you meet the Keeper of Time first time). Interact with your bed or tent and you will see an additional choice "Dream until next day".[/i]

[previewyoutube=siFOzW9UXMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]NEW FRIENDSHIP EVENTS[/b][/h3]
All 13 befriendable Npcs are now playable until level 5.

[h3][b]NEW TOURNAMENT: MALACHITE CUP[/b][/h3]
[i]How to unlock: Progress the friendship of all Npcs to level 5.[/i]

[h3][b]OVOSCOPE[/b][/h3]
An x-ray device which can store blob eggs and show you their content before hatching them.

[i]How to unlock: complete the Prehistoric Badlands blob world.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/a6e4c6276c71989f69e498fda6d02573545b4b45.png[/img]

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE + BALANCING + OTHER NEW CONTENT[/h1]

[h3][b]MOTION SICKNESS SETTINGS[/b][/h3]
[i]Based on feedback that some players experienced motion sickness when playing Ova Magica.[/i]
 
There are now 2 new settings in the pause menu which hopefully will prevent or reduce it:
[list]
[*]Disable Camera Smoothing:
Removes all camera “after smoothing /motion” which can greatly help when the motion sickness occurs mainly when moving the player character and rotating the camera.
[*]Battle Camera Setting: 
You can choose between the options “Dynamic (Default)”, “Less Rotation” and “Static” to help reduce motion sickness during battles.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/34f074d77814c2fa36d19523b55dea77d674baae.png[/img]

[h3][b]TEAM TERMINAL[/b][/h3]
[i]Based on players' feedback that switching blobs for farming, battling and other tasks was tedious.[/i]

Flint now sells the “Team Terminal” blueprint. Use it to register blob teams and swap between them quickly without having to go into blob barns and navigate the UI each time.

[previewyoutube=uBUJQ7PLKOE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]BLOB SKILL AND ABILITY INFOS[/b][/h3]
[i]Based on players' feedback to see more information what the skills and abilities of blobs do.[/i]

Descriptions for blob skills and abilities can now be displayed in several “UI locations” with the "Skill Info" button.

[previewyoutube=jl_RBrFg4gc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]MUSEUM INVENTORY OVERVIEW[/b][/h3]
You can now select the new choice “View museum inventory” when interacting with the donation box. The museum inventory lists already donated items and shows how many items are still missing in the botanic garden, dining hall and aquarium area of the museum.

[previewyoutube=_t7S4nyie1c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]MAGICAL STORAGE: NEW QUICK TRANSFER [/b][/h3]
[i]Based on feedback that players want instantly transfer items from the inventory to the magical storage without having to navigate through all the individual items.[/i]

With the new “Quick Transfer” button you can now move all items from your inventory to the magical storage which are already stored in the magical storage too.
[i]Note: the quick transfer does not occupy new free slots in the magical storage, if the max allowed amount of 999 for an item slot is reached[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/bbb19b48c16dcc8e41ff0c8f4733f37938ccded2.png[/img]

[h3][b]SAVING AT FAST TRAVEL SIGNS[/b][/h3]
[i]Based on players' feedback that it's tedious to walk back to your tent/house to save the game.[/i]

All fast travel points can now also be used to save the game (except in the Clover Town area during festivals).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/74d96f2e311a5547b978f15320e53da09bdf5ee9.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]BLOB SKILL OVERHAUL[/b][/h3]
The display of the old “Grade” (A-F) on blob skills was removed. Instead the status effects and stat value changes (attack, defense, speed) are now displayed for more infos.

[i]Reason:
The “Skill Grade” was an early concept that was not yet properly implemented. During several tests in Early Access, it ended up not working well with the battle balancing. A more “complex” system isn't always good and can cause confusion, so we decided to remove it and not force something into the game that doesn't really work well.[/i]

[h3][b]VARIOUS + QUALiTY OF LIFE[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] added new learnable recipes: Blob Island Cocktail (buy from Harold), Apple Pie (get in intro/farm tutorial), Homemade Lemonade (obtained in Flint's first heart event). All missed recipes from events are added automatic to existing Early Access save files.
[*] added several new unlockable skills to the player’s skill menu. Already spent skill points have been reset.
[*] time is stopped now at the boss stage in blob worlds (to avoid falling asleep before collecting the rewards)
[*] shooting stars appear now one hour earlier (8-11PM) to give a bit more time to collect the dropped items before falling asleep at midnight
[*] blobs which reach the highest happiness in blob barns now produce 2 items overnight
[*] added music for rainy days (before no music played)
[*] an icon is now displayed in the restaurant and beergarden dish selection on not yet learned recipes
[*] replaced the slide puzzle of the first Mystic Forest blob world with the easier lantern puzzle
[*] you can now choose between “Exit to Title” and “Quit Game” in the pause menu instead of always having to go to the title before closing the game
[*] feeders and most storage containers (chests) now show similar to the magical storage infos about items (based on feedback to see season of seeds and hela value of items)
[*] UI shown at the portal before entering a blob world and choosing your companion now shows the power level of the wild blobs in the world
[*] blob types: changed type of Sheep blob to Magma, changed type of Slot blob to Forest
[*] increased collect range of all fruits falling from trees (affected: apple, orange, cherry, coconut and heart fruit)
[*] the loading screen is now shown when saving the game at the bed until the save menu appears to avoid thinking the game has frozen. Reason: Loading save files can take a few seconds for very slow hard drives/devices and having a lot of existing manual save files.
[*] chests can now be renamed (+ changed blueprint name from “Storage Container” to “Chest”)
[*] can now hold the increase/decrease keys for inventory stack transfer + buying stacks
[*] can now hold the direction keys in several UIs
[*] Blobpedia now lists only already obtainable blobs during Early Access
[*] Reordered Blobs in the Blobpedia
[*] Blobpedia now also displays the energy costs of blob skills and abilities
[*] improved enemy KI to use less often skills, which only apply status effects but do no damage, when the status effect is already applied (effects among others the skills “Diamond Shield”, “Spikey”, “Poisonous Mushroom” and more)
[*] when having all manual save slots filled instead of the disabled “Create New Save” button now a new “Override Oldest Save” button is displayed
[*] added more names to the random blob name suggestions
[*] improved all loading times when changing areas and entering buildings. But the loading time when starting the game (before the title screen) is slightly longer now
[*] reduced required RAM in all areas. Mainly noticeable in the bigger outdoor scenes (Clover Valley and Clover Town).[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] added missing “Blob Action” (Default: Shift / Left Bumper ) to the control remap settings
[*] fixed that feeding rice to a blob with the Seed Scoop ability didn’t give rice seeds
[*] fixed that favorite temperature was not determined correct for bred blobs
[*] fixed that blobs on training devices or the auto petter where not healed overnight
[*] fixed that you could place some objects with the workbench inside some hills on your farm
[*] fixed that resetting settings didn’t reset the screen resolution correctly
[*] fixed that “Inspect” instead of “Talk” was shown when interacting with Helene
[*] fixed that the skater crew Npcs appeared sometimes in two locations parallel at the same day
[*] removed unreachable mud pile inside hill models near mine area
[*] reduced too high energy costs of toxic swamp
[*] changed MCs dialog slightly during Sleigh Swap festival to make more clear her blob is called Morrison
[*] fixed that blobs were not following the player correct in the Adventurers’ Club Intro event
[*] fixed several typos[/list]

Thank you for reading! We hope you enjoy the new features ♥

notes.title: NEW CONTENT UPDATE!
notes.notes:
The second major content update is available 🎉

[i]Note: Make sure to update to the [b]0.805[/b] version. If Steam doesn't update automatic, restart Steam. On Steam Deck games sometimes do not launch after updates, in this case restart your Steam Deck.[/i]


The team uses this occasion to thank all who got Ova Magica in 2024 (and early 2025)🙏. Your support during Early Access helps a lot paying for the localization and remaining development. 

We are looking forward to the full release and improving the game during the remaining Early Access period. If you have feedback and ideas do not hesitate to reach out via the Steam Forum or our [b][url=https://discord.gg/DcWXRqKAZQ]Discord[/url][/b].

Please also consider leaving a Steam review if you enjoy playing Ova Magica - it helps a lot 💚 !


[i]⚠️Important Note: Control/Button remapping settings: 
With progressing Early-Access development, we had to rework some of the code to make it future-proof. As a result, the old button remappings no longer work after this update. If you have previously changed the default controls, you will sadly have to redo them once. We apologize to all players affected by this. 
(The save data or any other settings are not affected. Only the key/button remapping in the pause menu settings.)[/i]


[h2]NEW ROADMAP CONTENT[/h2]
First we want to share the updated roadmap with you! The [b]current[/b] update is the [b]0.8[/b] version.

⚠️Attention: Below the roadmap pic are descriptions with SPOILERS of the new content! Stop reading after the roadmap if you do not want to be spoilered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/a45329b90d9ffc3845f8c4889a37e120da4fd0d8.png[/img]
[i]Important note for transparency: 
The 7th blob world which was initially not planned but added as Kickstarter stretchgoal was for now sadly removed from the roadmap to not delay the 1.0 release further. One of the main reasons is that we just need more time to polish the 6 main blob worlds and add still missing features to them.
We plan adding the 7th blob world in an update after full release also based on your ideas and feedback for possible new blobs + quests. We want to apologize for the change and hope for your understanding.[/i]


[h2]NEW BLOB WORLD: BAMBOO TEMPLE 🐼⛩️[/h2]
In the new blob world you can find several new blobs like the Tiger, Red Panda, Peacock and more. It also comes with new resources, like the Mithril ore vein, and the [b]greenhouse blueprint[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/b7dd4c93a32a039312ca09370a71c1305bafce29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/279c90572f4b2a13f7a95e492eaf5e4fd401885e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/d43f4366b6b16a9de1159c34e953cdd7d4d5664d.png[/img]

[h2]GREENHOUSE 🌱[/h2]
In the greenhouse you can grow different crops all year round. Comes with a sprinkler and a thermostat to set the season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/230a6c3bb35b2f18eaade9680eca0b03efd0595c.png[/img]

[h2]CAVE BEHIND THE WATERFALL[/h2]
Inside are signs of volcanic activity. This could also explain the hot spring that Garnet discovered and that powers the Spa. In the cave you can find new blobs, coal resources and the very rare [b]Emberpetal [/b] which can [b]revive a fainted blob[/b] in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/f4a6752588094707662c9a8982f837bea9478637.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/891151af6adfd023ec60a834e9649dcc459090fa.png[/img]

[h2]11 NEW FRIENDSHIP EVENTS 💛[/h2]
Level 4: Flint, Lapis, Emerald
Level 5: Garnet, Opal, Jasper, Carnelian, Citrine, Emerald, Ruby, Charoi

[h2]BLOB PARADISE[/h2]
Progress Flint's friendship to unlock the new building "Blob Paradise". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/31d6b8fa70f8f483cc183dd1dce8ea4ceb69c9cc.png[/img]

You can leave a blob in the Blob Paradise to train it. The maximum possible level is determined by your tournament rank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/afc14cc83635bb36072204d6e517575044ce6991.png[/img]

The Blob Paradise you can also purchase blueprints for devices which can train your blob stats. These are the [b]blob wheel[/b] (Speed), [b]trampoline [/b](Defense) and [b]training target[/b] (Attack).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/2517057d995ab8d76bd95c279e78ff6aef440078.png[/img]

[b]NEW ITEMS: HEALTH + ENERGY BOOSTER[/b]
Boosters permanently increase a blob's health or energy which helps to level up your blobs. This items are rare and can be found mainly in blob world chests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/a129718753a229a2e451b17251a62ea5b42d54a2.png[/img]

[h2]MITHRIL CUP TOURNAMENT 🏆[/h2]
Test your blob trainer skills in the Mithril Cup tournament! (unlocked with all NPCs friendship being level 4)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/afbf32f119ee5a03a0e7d2371f16d0925a12899e.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[b]Improved Farming Tool Controls[/b]
Can now hold the key/button for most farming actions instead having to press the key again.
Affected actions: watering crops, planting seeds, hoeing ground, harvesting crops

[b]Dropped items+crops do not disappear when leaving area[/b]
Crops and other items(for example dropped in the shooting start event or by wild blobs) do now not disappear when leaving an area. You can go inside your blob barn and return to the farm without worrying about the items being gone like before.
Not collected items are still removed on the next day.

Monday starts productive with an update and it's a big one! This update has several changes to gameplay, all based on the [b]most requested feedback[/b] 💚 

As devs the team is a bit anxious with changing things because it's always a risk some players enjoyed it the way it was and prefer no change. But we decided to take the risk based on the feedback players provided. Ova Magica is still in Early Access so this changes do not need to be final and the team continues to improve the game.

(Notes: 
You can get all changes in your current save file, no need to restart if you do not want to.
Make sure to update to 0.625 version: If Steam doesn't do the update automatic close and restart Steam.
On Steam Deck sometimes the Deck doesn't start games after updates, in this case restart the Steam Deck.)

[b]FEEDBACK: First blob world is too hard[/b]
Changes:
[list][*] Lowered Mystical Forest wild blobs level slightly (stage 1: level 12-15 instead before 15-18)
[*] After visiting Mystical Forest blob world there will be a gift in the mailbox to help with it (when you return to your farm)
[*] In the blob world the UI now also displays the wild blob level of the current stage (see upper left corner)  - so you can better estimate if your blobs are strong enough[/list]

[b]FEEDBACK: Blob stat leveling takes too long[/b]
Changes:
[list][*]  Doubled(!) experience when using a skill in battle. BUT:
[*] A skill can now level up only once per battle to avoid endless leveling in a single battle (stat values are now leveled at the end of battle for each skill being at 100% exp)[/list]

[b]FEEDBACK: Things are too expensive[/b]
Changes:[list]
[*]  Reduced most building prices (Charoi)
[*]  Reduced blob world rune costs (Harold)
[*]  Reduced prices vendors:
	Blob Eggs: 3000 (Before 3500)
	Blueprint Makers + co: 3000 (Before 5000)
	Blueprint Useful: 2500 (Before 4000)
	Blueprint Decorative: 1250 (Before 2500)
	Blob Toys: 1500 (Before 3000)
	Recipes: 1500 (Before 2500)
	Outfits: 1500 (Before 3500)
	Accessoires: 1250 (before: 2500)
	Big Blob Barn: 10000 (Before: 15000)[/list]

[h3]BIGGEST CHANGE - FEEDBACK: 4 day weeks are too short[/h3]
Change: 
Season has now 20 days instead of 12.

So the main reasons why players didn't like 4 days weeks was not having enough time between the festivals for other activities and feeling rushed (+it also being a lot different from most farm sims).

BUT increasing week length was not a good option because: At the beginning of a week a lot respawns like foraging items (herbs, mushrooms, flowers, sand, oysters and and and) and also the mine ores. So increasing the week length would result in waiting longer for the new items and would have negative effects on the gameplay - it was no option.

So there are now 2 additional weeks per season without festivals which increases the season length from 12 to 20 days and is now closer to the "usual" farm sim experience. Now you have some extra days to do all the things you want + more times to grow crops and profit in one season before crops wither on season change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/e95e8a05b219dd32a12c8ef301fa2ef8d90bd79c.png[/img]

To all who liked the fast pace with every week having a festival: Don't worry! For full game there will be still smaller events in this weeks so they wont get boring too💚! Just not in a festival style but smaller things (as example a special merchant visiting Clover Town). Feel free to share your ideas for this smaller events!

(Note: When loading your save file you will start in the week of the same festival before - so week 1-> week 1, week 2-> week 3, week 3-> week 5)

[b]VARIOUS IMPROVEMENTS + BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] added a 3rd skill to Jade’s blob Clara
[*] swapped "Sleep" and "Save Game" choice when interacting with bed/tent to avoid sleeping by accident.
[*] fixed missing pumpkin seeds in Jades store
[*] fixed rain sound being also played in blob world when visiting on a rainy day
[*] fixed timer not running in stacking ring game
[*] fixed that empty steamboard and watering can were refilled when moving to magical storage
[*] fixed strength bar not hiding after canceling hammer mini game with blobs
[*] fixed sound settings not affecting egg logo animation sound in title screen
[/list]

[h3]FINAL WORDS[/h3]
Thank you for reading so far and we hope this update will improve your gameplay experience 💚! The team will continue working hard towards the next major content update and more feedback + bug fixes. 

Some of you also asked how they can support us. Here are some things you can do:
[list]
[*] report bugs and feedback in the Steam forums or [url=https://discord.gg/jqfRH2ems3]Discord [/url]
[*] help other players with questions in case you know the reply
[*] share Ova Magica with your friends, on social media or create a video/lets play
[*] one of the most important: If you enjoy the game please leave a review. We are a small slowly growing indie team without a huge budget and reviews help us immensly to get some more visibility.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy playing further! See you until next update💚

[h1]Game Improvements[/h1]

Thank you to all who played the demo and provided feedback in the forum. We could already improve several things since the demo for the Early Access launch tomorrow.

Here is a little overview for you of the most important (not content-related): 

[b]Revised UI for mouse controlling[/b]
Battle and dialogs can now be controlled fully with mouse without having to use the keyboard (you can still use the keyboard).  All UIs have been reviewed to offer buttons which can be clicked with the mouse to control it as alternative without having to press specific keyboard keys.

[b]Added shop symbols to NPCs[/b]
Characters selling items have now an icon over their head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/03de3afb67f9f5edfb1eb6e3a02da344729498da.png[/img]

[b]Improved Player Movement Collision[/b]
You are now able to pass trough more narrow gaps than in the demo which feels more natural and also prevents to being "trapped in the wilderness" (:-P) when going to the back of your farm.

Example: In the demo passing between the tree and mud pile wasn't possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/f2734fc8872e72c23f6177ca5de5ef31dc80fe68.gif[/img]

[b]Balanced week length[/b]
Instead of 7 days a week has now 4 days. This results in seasons changing faster, festivals occuring more often and has a lot of benefits. Festivals help with raising friendship of all NPCs and faster changing seasons add more variety to the gameplay. And in case you missed unlocking things in year 1, you also don't have to play as long anymore to reach year 2. (Info : Day length itself was not reduced.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/a680ba405cb1a1d5ff2262ed0f31801bb70572a2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/f37d7ea8544dab8524a8f6f5901750e628bd5796.gif[/img]

Removed blob flashing in battle when selecting a target and blobs taking damage. Added in the settings menu an additional setting "Reduce flashing lights and effects" to disable also over-world some effects. Adding warning + information at the beginning of the game about photosensitivity.

notes.title: January + February Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Blobs[/h1]
We created some new Blobs for you♥:

[b]Red Panda and Platypus[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/10aee5b15298c51d22ac1d942ef5e8d1f06ac704.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/25b331ad87a93d572cd2bd0482ccd9a0a1c281ee.png[/img]


[h1]Blob Barn Overhaul[/h1]
In February I (Claudia) worked on numerous improvements and features for the barns!


In contrast to a previously fixed and expandable building, blob barns of various sizes are now available as a blueprint in the workbench! Which means what? You can place as many as you want and where you want!

[previewyoutube=IfbDGCvlRG8;full][/previewyoutube]

To make it easier for you to find a particular barn, you can now also change the icon. [b]Do you have any particular icon suggestions♥?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/926f72c8df6d5d278c56f65302dc9da60cc6bc79.png[/img]

A [b]big change[/b] from before, and something not found in many farming games, is that you can now decorate your barns just like the house by placing items over the workbench! 

You can place functional items, like a feeding station, but also decorative items. Your Blobs will feel happier if a barn matches their preferences.

[previewyoutube=6zJziD-jpEk;full][/previewyoutube]

I also implemented [b]blob pooping[/b] :-D When Blobs are fed, they will poop overnight. Keep the barn clean, otherwise your blobs won't feel comfortable. You can remove the poop with a shovel (this consumes stamina).

[previewyoutube=je0ciCkvqp0;full][/previewyoutube]

It is even easier when you unlock the blueprint for a litter box (several sizes can be found). Blobs then make their poop in it and you can easily empty the container in one go without using up stamina and time. Also a blobs mood doesn't get affected by poops in a litter box (so you avoid to having to empty it daily).

[previewyoutube=kL4Y8AESguw;full][/previewyoutube]

And what do you do with the poop? You can use it as fertilizer, for example. One idea from the community is a [b]compost pile[/b] that produces fertilizer over several days.[b] What do you think of this idea?[/b]


[h1]Blob Mood and Products[/h1]
Some blobs produce items overnight in a blob barn.  A new addition is that the pig blob produces meat. Do not ask about the logic, we do not slaughter blobs;-P!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/3433521354ff726d28ff698bf7cae5e1adf1accf.png[/img]

For this they must be fed and their mood must not be bad. If its mood is at the highest level, it may happen that a blob will produce a very special item( secret:-) ).  Also blobs need to be in good mood to breed and the highest mood guarantees a better result. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/e4499b2e16af4496fbc10142bc2ffca13ddc18d8.png[/img]

Several factors influence the happiness of a blob (Icons from left to right):

 [list]
[*] Barn decoration: When a barn is decorated with things a blob likes, its mood is higher
[*]  Temperature: If the temperature is too different from the one a blob wants, it will be unhappy (see more below)
[*]  Barn Cleanness: Each poop in the blob barn reduced the blob mood. Poops in the litter box, do not affect mood
[*]  Affection: Petting a bob raises the mood and a blob is sad when it gets neglected for too long
[/list]

[h1]Barn Temperature[/h1]
Different blobs have different preferences for temperature. Some like it especially warm, others cold. The mood of a blob is better the closer the temperature is to its preference. If the temperature difference is too great, a blob is unhappy and will not produce items.

The temperature in the barn depends on the seasons. However, you can influence it with items, such as an air conditioner. Be sure to keep blobs with similar temperature preferences together in a barn.

In the video, the player checks the temperature of the barn (upper left corner in the UI- still WIP), then the mood of the cow blobs. Then they place an air conditioner, which changes the temperature from warm to comfortable, and the mood of the two cow blobs rises♥

[previewyoutube=96mujPZZ5zA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New fish: Shrimp[/h1]
You can now also fish for shrimp and use them to cook several dishes.

[previewyoutube=sXhfH6VInV8;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of you may have noticed the new beach texture in the video. Several of you found the old beach too colorful, so the texture has now been changed♥ Again thank you for your feedback on this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/799e47d2ea97f98fdee2603f5855a087147ca87b.png[/img]

[h1]"Shiny" Blob Experimentation[/h1]
When you breed blobs you have a very small chance for a especially strong result  due to mutations(comparable to shiny Pokemon). I am still searching for a good name and also experimenting with effects. I tried a rainbow effect but i am not happy yet (it's maybe too bold and "agressive"). But still wanted to share with you the first steps♥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/ac15b7bd5502aea62331b8ef22a74bbac264bec7.gif[/img]

[h1]New Potraits[/h1]
Our artist Ichigo*Ranch also created  new swim/beach wear potraits for Lapis, Opal And Jasper!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/54d807a08ab7bbe97b7ae9456d1f21feb6bb0eef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/7fbf628b53ac0b506c8972bfab1a7c1482ed6d70.png[/img]

[h1]Final Words[/h1]
Thanks for reading so far! Actually, I wanted to introduce you in this update some of the numerous NPCs of Clover Town on which we have worked continuously over the past months. However, the update is now already quite, so I save that for the next update.

The team wishes you a good start into march. Until next time♥!

notes.notes:

This blob lays small eggs that can be used for cooking. It is popular with the farmers of Clover Town and the eggs are sold at the local market. As soon as the hen blob mates with another blob, it lays a larger blob egg.

notes.title: Blob Advent Calendar - Day 7
notes.notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/69c0dcd99f6add09358efa693d1cb44c4c896b93.gif[/img]

notes.title: Blob Advent Calendar - Day 6
notes.notes:
[h2]Cheetah Blob[/h2]
The cheetah blob is difficult to tame, but also a very strong fellow in battle, whose attacks are based primarily on speed. It is especially popular amongst treasure hunters, as it can dodge traps well and escape quickly from dicey situations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/261fde5e55d8d41179f4a69b5d4a866b7c90ad57.gif[/img]

notes.title: Blob Advent Calendar - Day 5
notes.notes:

The clover blob is so rare that some do not believe that it really exists. People say that its owner will be fortunate forever.

notes.title: September Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This is a big update and includes quite a bit of stuff, so sorry for the delay! Formatting to Steam with the amount of images was also a hassle. 

[b]Firstly, Ova Magica now has a professional writer🥳 - Meet Renkka![/b]

Renkka is a writer who specializes in visual novels and character-driven narratives. She's worked on games such as BTS Universe Story, Bistro Days, and Mizari Loves Company. 

Renkka enjoys writing about anything from coffee shop romances to thrilling paranormal adventures, and, now, about the wonderful, colorful world of Ova Magica!

Her creative inspirations (and all-time favorite titles) include Pokemon, Ace Attorney, Danganronpa, and The House in Fata Morgana.

[h2]The last weeks we have already worked diligently on the events of the romanceable characters. Here are some teasers for you![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/3809aada4e4ac679d13a70c2c3ba80b1a4c110ee.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/1fd8d0918c70e886756d62c8304c40bd26727c87.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/51b7958be2ae22b28b724145f449131a887389a9.gif[/img]

[h2]New Blobs[/h2]
There are some new blobs as well!

[b]Birthday Blob[/b]

For your (in-game )birthday you will get this special blob🎁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/7480b968c935035568438d3267e025cd69e4cf15.gif[/img]

[b]Lotus Blob[/b]

These blobs live in the pond and do not like to be disturbed. They are not necessarily the strongest but the fight with them should not be underestimated. Due to their special skill "Healing Lotus" they are especially dangerous in groups. (You can see more about the lotus blob below under "Fishing").

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/15f0cce6e3e27a7d11ca393c5ccd8271bc327f05.gif[/img]

[b]Orca blob[/b]

These blobs are spotted near Clover Towns's beach, especially during the winter season "Frigus".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/b15c7509d8be2d73a731eae384902bb15731e45f.gif[/img]

Many wished for a shark blob but there will be none base blob in the game. However, you can breed the orca and tiger blob relatively easily into a tiger shark themed blob. Here is an example:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/aedee9b88c86d7a8a29f05a34002c7fa3f52de5e.gif[/img]

[b]Sheepo blob[/b]

Cute and fluffy and it can produce wool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/4ff5880888c8f223e57248d020ee4354923fbafc.gif[/img]

[h2]Wedding Outfits👰 [/h2]

Our artist Ichigoranch has started drawing the first wedding outfits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/b43b03c662dc7c16d964d983906860233c7c3334.gif[/img]

I don't want to spoil the special moment for you, so I'll show you only small teasers of the outfits. But I can assure you, they are gorgeous!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/c6f96bc574510789ddbc12159650728a8fecb02d.gif[/img]

Can you guess the character?

[h2] Fishing [/h2]

Some time ago I asked you for ideas and feedback for the fishing system. Most of you wanted a simple system and no complicated mini game. Thanks to your feedback I could now finish the base and I present you here the new mechanics!

[b]1. Watch where you throw your bait![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/752f1c8fa6eb6b75bbdcc705520143125bdce21f.gif[/img]

Blobs don't like to be disturbed and can get angry when something hits them in the head!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/986439964a8134e1bcea9e4411e2d091130119f9.gif[/img]

[b]2. Watch the bait closely![/b]

In the video below you can see that the color of the exclamation mark changes. If you press at the "right" moment (black) then you catch a fish (or sth else). If you press in the "wrong" (red) a battle starts. So watch the bait well! I have intentionally chosen that you can see when a blob bites so that you can avoid the fights. However, through the battles you also have the possibility to get some blob eggs... so what will you hunt - fish or blobs?

[h2] Usability Improvement [/h2]

You can now challenge characters to battle with a simple button press instead of a tedious dialog selection! The test video below shows you how it looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/5c0bdf2a016ef68e85dc2ef5fcb79f64a3ecf669.gif[/img]

Thank you for reading everyone, and have a wonderful rest of september!

notes.title: Camera mode preview and interiors!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is our [b]periodic development update for Ova Magica[/b] where you'll learn about some of the recent features and progress being added to the game! 

Do you remember one of the stretch goal features was the special [b]photo mode[/b]? Recently I've been working on how this will work in-game! There will also be some funny moments and special objects like photo booths or cut-outs around Clover Town where you will be able to make special poses with your blobs and to capture these memories. There will also be several items in-game related to photography, so be sure to explore the world and market to make best use of this feature!

The other thing being worked on are the [b]building interiors and NPC houses[/b]. Everybody needs somewhere to call a home, no matter if it's yourself or one of Ova Magica's lovable NPCs! [b]Each house communicates the character and personality of the person who owns it[/b]. For example, Garnet and Saphir's beachside eatery is sea themed, whereas Lazuli's room is cute and full of soft things.

The [b]soundtrack[/b] for the game is also being worked on and [b]new music[/b] is arriving! Describing everything is one thing, but how about showing all of these things together? So that's why for this update we've compiled everything into a neat little [b]video for you to watch[/b]. Check it out below!

notes.title: Aquatic delights! Museum, fishing, and development updates
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We are really happy to bring you a periodic development update for the game. Thanks to the success of fundraising efforts, development on Ova Magica is in full swing, with additional content being added that wasn't possible before! One of these is the Clover Town Museum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/994116cec656eb3c4708b7b355f761b65bcf3eb9.gif[/img]

[h3]Clover Museum Aquarium[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/9dcdf0716299fda356c0f6f8578e847617ce55c1.gif[/img]

First up, we are building the aquarium exhibit within the museum. Say hello to the Octopus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/ce8285ccf35cd6d963b94fda87d9c1b70bcfa84a.gif[/img]

This exhibit will allow you to help Emerald and the custodian catalogue the various different creatures living in the rivers and canals around Clover Town. As you help donate more to the museum, you'll see the tanks gradually fill it up with the fish that you donate! Perhaps as you help to document certain rare creatures, there might even be a reward in it for you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/b7f51eee4dc499960e423e5c4e4c49524b29484c.png[/img]

As you can see, the room itself is a bit basic currently as a blockout, but the design of the aquarium tank itself is done. We look forward to showing you the finished design when it's fully laid out and decorated!

[h3]Fishing mechanics[/h3]

Why work on the aquarium first? It goes hand in hand with the fishing mechanics, which are also being designed currently! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/7fd88fd78c54a2a60cbbd27c63e5643d7e119e14.gif[/img]

Fishing is of course, a key part of a farming game, and there's plenty of ways it's been done across all the farming games out there. In order to help with the development, you can give us your opinion!

[list]
[*] In which games did you enjoy fishing (or not) and why? Any idea or inspiration for a fishing mini-game mechanic?
[*] What would you like to be able to fish in Ova Magica? And how about wild blobs that bite from time to time?
[*] What kinds of aquatic life would you like to see?
[/list]

Last but not least, did you know Ova Magica has a Discord server? Please join it in order to follow development of the game more closely! Also, please remember to WISHLIST the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/370b50443312b4648ac6644af3bd97e3167e470b.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 24 - Celestial blob[/b][/u]
Stories are told that on the night of the shooting stars a blob egg will fall from the sky, carrying a miracle...
Enjoy the holidays with your loved ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/bb5539b7975d60b2795b56138d5d7fcfa531cb1f.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 23 - Pumpkin blob[/b][/u]
On the night of the "Spooky Moon Festival" this blob roams trough Clover Town.
I chose this blob for today for some nightmare before Christmas vibes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/c0c70fb44eac880d7fe0f451dd983fdb1d1141ef.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 22 - Dragonfly blob[/b][/u]
This blob is very rare. With luck you can find it at wild lakes. But it is shy and before you know, it is gone...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/cbb5a7e58d282755c822169af87258fa7d970f07.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 21 - Flower bunny blob[/b][/u]
This blob is stronger than it looks! Its magical blossom attacks can get even the strongest trainers in trouble...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/aeb21a27a0da6b6f4fdf4949f8695517be39e39f.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 20 - Crow blob[/b][/u]
Better put up a scarecrow! Otherwise, this blob will eat your crops...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/0464c294736a6c32872794d6aa5d453c24ee5ade.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 19 - Storm starter blob[/b][/u]
At the beginning you can choose one of the three starter blobs! What type will you pick - Forest, Storm or Magma?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/810afbe0dbd0147c57ee081209fe7879ba5f1997.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 18 - Poo blob[/b][/u]
This blob is very kind and often tries to get close to people. However, to its surprise, people avoid it... If only they knew that its ability "Fertilizer" is very useful for growing plants

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/d418561d0118ec5d096ea28c6b4ea7d3d9257f92.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 17 - Bomb blob[/b][/u]
This blob has a very high attack power. But it's not only useful in battle. With its ability "Explosion" it can help you remove barriers or gather raw materials fast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/ec2054b29bf3a6876b7b4da3843f8773d757274d.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 16 - Angler blob[/b][/u]
If you like fishing, this blob is your best companion. He can attract fish with its light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/a32a637c078c67a7f9284aa06cbb27bc93afc0d0.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 15 - Bat blob[/b][/u]
You can find this blob mainly in caves. With its special soundwaveSpeaker with three sound waves ability it can help you catch bugs by confusing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/9f464cf9ad37a3b46c95fcc86faf212bb21bc690.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 14 - Turtle blob[/b][/u]
Although this blob is rather slow moving, many trainers choose it for battle. Due to its hard shell, it can withstand a lot of hits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/b5e71e5dc668f586586941fff7f7e9bb83350f17.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 13 - Pig blob[/b][/u]
This blob may not be the best fighter, but it has an excellent nose and can dig up delicious mushrooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/051bc6cc45e2cefc459e70d90dc5f61fc112c1a5.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 12 - Magma starter blob[/b][/u]
At the beginning you can choose one of the three starter blobs! What type will you pick - Forest, Storm or Magma?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/f868ff3f7489ec8598a6555cde513c4b3689bb04.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 11 - Moon cat blob[/b][/u]
Some believe this blob came from the moon...
A tribute to the favorite childhood series of the dev.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/48146fbfa8139612b3115d0b76d1479088fc5411.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 10 - Bee blob[/b][/u]
This small blob feels most at home in flower meadows and usually lives in larger swarms. It is friendly but bravely defends its hive when it has to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/ff4d1c439332adbc69dc62ee9a4b9874fcb8fe4b.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 9 - Hedgehog blob[/b][/u]
Despite its spikes this blob is friendly but above all curious. It often plunders backpacks of resting hikers when they aren't looking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/0eb48efdfca656bd082b01613aad10130ec56f48.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 8 - Mushroom blob[/b][/u]
Keep your eyes open when you go mushrooming in the forest! This little guy may not be the strongest, but you should be careful of his poisonous attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/a5e30d786e0056f088f89ffa649dc1857421f2b2.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 7 - Demon blob[/b][/u]
Even the best trainers have difficulties to defeat this blob. Its fiery skills can wipe out your entire team with just one blow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/c6deb6db8319897a8fecacfb807aa1ae3494208f.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 6 - Forest starter blob[/b][/u]
At the beginning you can choose one of the three starter blobs! What type will you pick - Forest, Storm or Magma?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/2e36b862a86a1013695c3af723ab9a2ea4f6880d.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 5 - Tiger blob[/b][/u]
This blob is hard to train and makes a lot of mischief. If it accepts you as a trainer it is a loyal companion and a strong fighter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/86aa0841a411a25f0240f8f5c7122db78086abfa.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 4 - Butterfly blob[/b][/u]
This small and curious blob loves fragrant things! Maybe you can lure it if you plant many flowers on your farm...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/f50fc716adbf8c3ff58bee00f8c130c5f987aa80.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 3 - Crab blob[/b][/u]
It doesn't like to be disturbed. Stories are told of badly mauled treasure hunters who came too close to it on the beach...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/c5d0901da4d95c5cbb1cf4c2085c20f2f39c5945.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 2 - Penguin blob[/b][/u]
This friendly, but also a little clumsy blob, feels most comfortable in the winter season Frigus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/c412ef0364c266da8de92741b27d5efba69f7206.gif[/img]

[u][b]Day 1 - Cow blob[/b][/u]
It's not very strong in battle, but it can produce fresh milk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38620452/ee18f339e9f8500d591da0b523a7392fe3506208.gif[/img]
